description: Depth-32 binary Keccak IMT, 64 independent masked child proofs, 32 first aggregates, 31 same-key merges, one independently verified final proof.
limitations: One release run on an Apple M2 Pro with eight workers and one active proving node. Ranges and medians describe nodes within the run.

Aggregation wall time sums measured first-aggregation and merge stages. It excludes child generation, setup and negative checks. Each stage includes proof import, proving and intermediate verification.
A separate experimental circuit setup overlapped initial setup and early child proofs. It finished before aggregation started. Compilation finished before this integration test.
The original 64-child benchmark used four workers and a different circuit layout. These full-tree runs cannot isolate a code-only speedup.
Formal statistical zero knowledge of the child proofs and an end-to-end 128-bit security bound have not been established.

eight_worker_comparison.method: One eight-child release run per binary on the same Apple M2 Pro, eight Rayon workers, one active node and independently generated child proofs. Compare the sum of all seven aggregation-node wall times. This omits cross-node I/O, setup and test overhead. Both independent final verifications and all malformed-input checks passed.
eight_worker_comparison.limitations: The baseline binary includes the legacy prime-field feature. Both measured proof paths use the same depth-32 binary Keccak protocol, child authority and Johnson parameters. Absolute timings vary across runs.
